summary: Baker County, Oregon ranch lookout three miles south of North Powder, run by cooperator J. Wylie Dalton; tower built in the 1930s, now gone; private land.

facts.status_note: Tower gone per the register; firelookout.com lists it as abandoned

access.note: Private ranch land per the register (administered by Private) and firelookout.com (Private Co-op); no public access described

facts.agency: Private owner (Dalton ranch), with a cooperator lookout arrangement

events.note: Daley road fire, the August before a January 1930 report (year inferred from 'last August')
Rancher J. Wylie Dalton acted as lookoutman, crew organizer and firefighter (January 1930 report); register gives the tower as 1930s
Lookout tower built in the 1930s (register and firelookout.com); exact year not given, so 1930 is a placeholder for the decade
Registered November 19, 2019; nominated by Tammy McLeod

corrections.why: The register and firelookout.com say the tower was built in the 1930s. No source gives 1930 as the build year; a January 1930 report describes the cooperator arrangement, not a tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says 'the 1930's' and firelookout.com says '1930s: tower'; both agree. The Forest Lookouts site does not describe a tower, only the cooperator arrangement in 1930.

notes_for_editor: Gone site on private ranch land: no source describes the site today, so the story says so and advises asking the owner. The brief's 1930 build year is replaced with the register's 1930s; the 1930 staffing entry is the cooperator arrangement from the January 1930 report, not a tower. The Daley road fire year (1929) is inferred from 'last August' in a January 1930 report and is marked so in the event note. The register's build field is blank except for the 1930's, and firelookout.com gives only 1930s. The 1936 panorama is credited by caption only, so no photo record with an image URL was added.
